kind_why: A combat surf map: built to fight on rather than to time (see notes). 'arena' keeps it out of g2gfast's rotation, vote and nominations -- it stays installed, loadable with `map`, and listed on M as combat -- and marks it for game-arena's deathmatch.
author: akai
notes: Credit only, and deliberately no zones: a combat surf map with no finish (see maps/zones/README.md). Team spawns, 42 placed weapons and 17 func_buttons; 43 of its trigger_teleports aim at one 'targ1' and the rest at per-team floor and anti-stuck teleports -- a fight in a loop, not a route. gb-maps-1 batch of 2026-10-09. Not published.
